description: DialogBrain gives AI agents access to all your messaging channels — Telegram, WhatsApp, Instagram, Email, and more — through a single MCP interface. Read conversations, send messages, search contacts, and manage threads across 10+ channels. Perfect for LangGraph, Claude, and any MCP-compatible agent framework.
